summary_1line: Kaikeyi demands Rama’s exile and Bharata’s coronation; King Dasaratha collapses in anguish, pleading desperately but bound by his promise.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha collapses to the floor crying 'O Rama, Rama!' while Kaikeyi sits unmoved beside him in the dim royal chamber.
Dasaratha, distraught, bows at Kaikeyi’s feet in supplication as she coldly demands Rama’s fourteen-year exile and Bharata’s coronation.
The aged king lies fainted on the palace floor like a felled tree while Kaikeyi stands firm, her expression hardened by resolve.
